summary.en: Rumi-sensei and the kids are back in Rumi's apartment, where Conan informs them that he suspects Banno is the murderer. Conan finds a convenience store receipt dated that morning under his sitting mat as they discuss how he did it. This causes Conan to remember she was late this morning. When asked why, Rumi says she went to the convenience store in the morning because her fridge was empty. The time school usually sells a lot of items outlets out. As a result, she was late for school, which is an uncommon occurrence for her. Conan, Mitsuhiko, and Wakasa overhear Takagi and Megure discussing the case and walk in on Haibara, trying to write on her face using her phone as a mirror but failing miserably. She can't erase the funny scribble that's supposed to be 'A' (あ) because she accidentally used a permanent marker. We then learn that Genta fell asleep on the painting and wakes up with a tiger mark on his face from the paint. Also we learn Genta's hand smells of ladies' foundation.
